# requires: store
#
# The first notice a listener gets is the present -- what is true, whether or
# not anything moved since before it attached. A listener attaching late sees
# a running job as running, never a history it has to replay.
watch W 300
next W
submit A size=64 digest=good src=file
next W
claim A alpha 60000
watch V 300
next V

# expect 2: changed [WATCH-P1]
# expect 2: -
# expect 4: changed
# expect 4: A=pending/0
# expect 7: changed [WATCH-P1]
# expect 7: A=running/0
